_note: victor_disentangle_v2 (adversarial disentanglement): v1 with ONE change, adversarial_weight 0 -> 1.0. The spies now act through the gradient reversal layer: the disease branch is pushed to remove what lets its spy guess the crop, and the crop branch to remove what lets its spy guess the disease. Strength ramps from 0 to 1.0 over training (DANN schedule), 1.0 being the DANN default. v2 vs v1 isolates the adversarial loss.
_result: Adversarial weight 1.0 is far too strong: harmonic mean 36.9% top-1 / 71.6% top-5 (v1 54.4%, D0 57.9%). Seen top-1 28.1%, unseen 53.6%, gamma 4.9; the unseen-only diagnostic fell to 58.0% (v1 75.6%). The adversary works mechanically: the crop spy's accuracy on z_dis fell from 96% (v1) to about 24%, and the disease spy's on z_crop to about 17%. But the main heads paid for it: train crop accuracy stopped near 85-89% (v1 99%), and validation HM peaked at epoch 1-2 (43-44%) and then sank to about 40% as the strength ramped up, so selection picked epoch 2. Two readings: (1) the reversed gradient also reaches the shared backbone, and pushing it to hide crop (for z_dis) and disease (for z_crop) at the same time strips information both heads need; (2) some crop context really helps disease recognition, even for unseen pairs (the diagnostic fell). Also a trainer issue, fixed after this run: the ramp ran over the refit's own length, so the 2-epoch final fit reached full strength while stage 1 had only about 0.46 at epoch 2.

model._note: Backbone and dropout as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn. z_dim: width of each branch output (z_crop, z_dis). spy_hidden: hidden width of each spy (a 2-layer MLP, so it can detect non-linear leakage, as in DANN).

disentangle._note: adversarial_weight: GRL strength (how hard the branches are pushed to fool the spies); 0 = spies only observe. adversarial_ramp: DANN schedule that raises the strength from 0 to adversarial_weight over training. decorrelation_weight: weight of the cross-correlation penalty between z_crop and z_dis; 0 = off.

loss._note: Same as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn for the two heads (CE + label smoothing 0.1, equal weights). The spy losses are plain CE with weight 1.

optimizer._note: Same as aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn; lr_head applies to the branches, heads and spies.
